research_problem: LLMs (even GPT-4) generate inaccurate API arguments and hallucinate API usage; web-scale, overlapping, changing API sets cannot fit in context and lack benchmarks
technical_approach: APIBench (1,645 TorchHub/TF Hub/HuggingFace ML API calls, 10 GPT-4 self-instruct instructions each); retriever-aware instruction fine-tuning of LLaMA-7B (Gorilla) with appended documentation; AST sub-tree matching for accuracy and hallucination (non-existent API) measurement; constraint-aware evaluation
primary_contribution: Fine-tuned API-calling LLM with retrieval-aware training and an API hallucination benchmark/metric
dataset_benchmark: APIBench: ~11K instruction-API pairs over 1,645 ML model APIs; holdout split from self-instruct pairs
evaluation_metrics: AST accuracy, hallucination rate, wrong-API error
baselines: GPT-4, GPT-3.5, Claude-v1, LLaMA-7B; zero-shot, BM25, GPT-Index, oracle retrievers
key_findings: Zero-shot Gorilla beats GPT-4 by 20.43% and ChatGPT by 10.75%; imperfect retrievers at test time hurt (up to -47.57%); retriever-aware training with oracle docs helps (+12.37% TorchHub, +23.46% HF) but non-oracle retrievers degrade it (up to -52.27%); GPT-4 hallucinates more than GPT-3.5; qualitative adaptation to documentation changes; accuracy drops under constraints
author_limitations: ML domain chosen for difficulty; potential bias of ML APIs; execution out of scope (no explicit limitations section)
analyst_limitations: Instruction-level split leaves same APIs in train and test (memorisation); unequal HuggingFace evaluation for baselines; ML-hub single calls not REST/multi-step; AST match without execution; GPT-4-generated instructions; count inconsistencies (696 vs 626); documentation-change adaptation only anecdotal
reproducibility: High: code, model and data released
suggested_extensions: OpenAPI/REST hallucination benchmark with spec validation and execution; API-level and time-based unseen splits; robustness to noisy retrieved docs; constraint-aware selection with cost/latency/rate limits; quantitative documentation-change benchmark
evidence_location: APIBench p.2-4; training p.4-5; AST metric p.5; results p.7-9 Tables 1-3; conclusion p.9
